purpose: Diagnose whether the v4 canary failures are harness-bound or model-bound by running the same frozen task, models, and route under the pi coding agent (free-form tools, no output-cap pressure, no action-JSON protocol). One attempt per model cell.

claim_boundary.comparison_use: hypothesis-generating contrast with the v4 canary cells only

hypotheses_from_v4.gemma: Gemma 4 31B attempted the implementation write and was truncated at AskMe's 1536-token retry cap; with an 8192-token budget and free-form edit tools it should at least deliver a nonempty patch.
hypotheses_from_v4.qwen: Qwen3.6 27B never selected a write action under AskMe's action menu despite no truncation pressure; tests whether a free-form interface elicits any write at all.

harness_under_test.name: pi coding agent
harness_under_test.reasoning: disabled in both cells (reasoning:false, supportsReasoningEffort:false) so the ablation varies the harness, not the reasoning policy
harness_under_test.step_cap: none (pi has no native turn cap); wall-clock cap and proxy call cap only

route_enforcement.mechanism: host-side forwarding proxy (openrouter_pin_proxy.py) injects the provider block, restricts the request model to the cell's pinned ID, caps calls, and tees every request/response body for the post-run route audit
route_enforcement.credential_isolation: real OPENROUTER_API_KEY exists only in the host proxy process; the container, pi, and model-issued commands see only a per-run random secret that is useless outside the proxy's lifetime
route_enforcement.post_run_audit: every teed response frame must report served provider SiliconFlow and the exact dated served model; any other value fails the run

known_deviations_from_canary_protocol: no command-level guard: pi's bash tool is unrestricted inside the container (trusted pinned task only; do not reuse on untrusted tasks)
no per-step or planning budgets; wall clock and proxy call cap bound the run
the per-run proxy secret is visible inside the container, so model-issued commands could call the proxy directly; spend is bounded by the call cap and allowed-model pin
no gold/harmless control reruns (the v4 controls on the identical image/dataset/evaluator stand; this is not a qualification run)
session capture is pi's own JSONL plus the proxy tee, not AskMe's run log schema

per_cell: pi exit code and agent_end presence (agent completion)
patch bytes and official evaluator patch_successfully_applied / resolved
route audit: calls, served models/providers, usage, finish reasons
credential-leak grep over all retained artifacts
